patthana14.37:1.1: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo ca na araṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana14.37:2.1: araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana14.37:3.1: saraṇañca araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana14.37:4.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇo dve, avigate pañca,
patthana14.37:5.1: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo dhammo uppajjati
patthana14.37:7.1: na hetuyā dve, na ārammaṇe tīṇi. no vigate tīṇi,
patthana14.37:8.1: (sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi nissayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi paṭiccavārasadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)
patthana14.37:9.1: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. saraṇo dhammo na araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa ca araṇassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana14.37:10.1: araṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana14.37:11.1: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. saraṇo dhammo na araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. …pe…
patthana14.37:12.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cattāri, adhipatiyā pañca, anantare cattāri, avigate pañca.
patthana14.37:13.1: saraṇo dhammo na saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. sahajātapaccayena paccayo. upanissayapaccayena paccayo. pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. kammapaccayena paccayo.
patthana14.37:14.1: saraṇo dhammo na araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. sahajātapaccayena paccayo. upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana14.37:17.1: ārammaṇe cattāri, na hetupaccayā ārammaṇe cattāri.
patthana14.37:18.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvāraṃ evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.) anulomaṃ paccanīya dukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
